name: Text stream
description: Rows of text carried along gentle waves, like words on a current, each row at its own pace.

props.name: text
props.description: The text to carry. One string is used on every row; an array gives each row its own line, repeating if there are more rows than lines.

props.name: rows
props.description: How many rows. They share the height, and differ in size, opacity and speed; alternate rows travel the other way.

props.name: speed
props.description: Multiplier for every row's speed. Hovering slows the stream to about a fifth.

props.name: amplitude
props.description: Height of the waves, in pixels, from the middle of a row.

props.name: wavelength
props.description: Length of one wave, in pixels.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the stream. Give it a height; the text takes its font family, weight and colour from here, and the left and right edges fade out.
